items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And Zutty went back and you had worked for Nappy Lumare (Lemone?) in Studio City Club in '47.

ctx.x: And Zutty went back and you had worked for Nappy Lumare (Lemone?) in Studio City Club in '47. Because I never forget, I still have it on the postcard. When Zutty got through with this road tour with Hacket and Condon and was coming back to California, they sent out postcards. Zutty's back and we got him (LAUGHTER). We mailed that to the mailing list. Zutty went right back in Club 47.
And then after I left Club 47 I went to the Knotty Pine.
